phase_0.boundary_condition: the Minoan Cretan fired clay disc of c.1700 BCE as a roughly circular artifact containing a single continuous spiral channel, 241 signs, 45 nested lines, 45 triangular wedges, and no parallel or bilingual text
phase_0.domain_name: Phaistos Disc: a fired clay disc, roughly circular, bearing
phase_0.justification: Auto-designed by the native Ob3ect Auto-Designer (in-process candle, no Python)

AFWD.justification: pressing the channel from the outer rim toward the center and placing sign tokens along the line arm direct the blank disc into a continuous readable path

AREV.justification: the wedge arm and the reading path descend from the outer rim into the center, turning the rim boundary into an inward sequence of signs and separators

CLINK.justification: the 241 stamped signs are composed in order along the continuous spiral from rim to center

ENGAGR.justification: the disc is held as both fired clay object and closed semiotic system at the same time

EVALF.justification: the stamp arm refutes any impression that is not one of the 25 distinct stamps

EVALT.justification: the mark arm affirms a physical impression present in the clay at a spiral position

FFUSE.justification: the mark and stamp arms rejoin into sign tokens, then the line and wedge arms rejoin into one spiral of 45 nested lines separated by wedges

FSPLIT.justification: the spiral opens into a line arm carrying 241 signs and a wedge arm carrying 45 triangular separators, while each sign impression opens into a mark arm and a stamp arm

IFIX.justification: firing permanently fixes the impressions, wedges, and spiral channel in the clay

IMSCRIB.justification: each sign is recognized as itself within the disc, with no parallel or bilingual text outside the object

TANCH.justification: the fired roughly circular boundary contains the spiral channel, 241 signs, 45 nested lines, and 45 triangular wedges as one artifact

VINIT.justification: before the spiral channel, 241 signs, 45 lines, 45 wedges, and 25 stamps are named, the disc is a blank circular surface with no readable sequence

phase_2.fuse_result: one spiral of 45 nested lines separated by wedges
phase_2.rejoin_note: the line arm forms sign tokens from mark and stamp arms, the wedge arm sets separators, then the arms rejoin into the nested spiral.
phase_2.verdict_reason: Tri-ancestral reconnection over a transformed object — closes

phase_3.both_description: B4 B (11): both held at once, a live contradiction, the paraconsistent resolution
phase_3.void_description: B4 N (00): neither, uninitialized, nothing established

steps.domain_action: uninscribed Minoan Cretan clay disc before any spiral channel, sign, wedge, or stamp is named
form a continuous spiral channel from the outer rim toward the center
open the spiral channel into a line arm and a wedge arm
open the line arm into a mark arm and a stamp arm
affirm the visible stamped impression on the mark arm
refute any impression outside the 25 distinct stamps on the stamp arm
rejoin the mark arm and stamp arm into one sign token at each spiral position
place 241 sign tokens along the line arm
descend the wedge arm from rim to center, setting 45 triangular wedges between nested lines
rejoin the line arm and wedge arm into one spiral of 45 nested lines
chain the 241 sign tokens along the continuous spiral
read the chained signs from the outer rim toward the center
recognize the disc as a self-contained semiotic object with no parallel text
hold the disc as both fired clay artifact and closed sign system
fix the impressions, wedges, and spiral channel by firing the clay
seal the fired disc as the closed boundary of the object

phase_5.alfs_store: the 25 distinct stamps form the canonical reference set for the 241 sign impressions
phase_5.compiler_frontend: the 25-stamp set and spiral layout translate intended signs into stamped impressions on clay
phase_5.ipc_mechanism: the spiral channel passes sign order from one nested line to the next, with triangular wedges marking line boundaries
phase_5.memory_mechanism: the fired clay stores impressions, wedges, and line positions as permanent physical marks
phase_5.scheduler_mechanism: the reading order runs from the outer rim toward the center along the continuous spiral

phase_6.cycle_cost: clay deformation and stamp pressure per impression
phase_6.delta_s_verdict: ΔS ≈ 0: the cycle preserves the finite sign inventory, line count, wedge count, and spiral order while fixing the same marks in clay.
phase_6.post_cycle_state: fired disc with 241 signs, 45 nested lines, 45 triangular wedges, and a fixed 25-stamp set
phase_6.pre_cycle_state: uninscribed clay disc with no signs, lines, or wedges
